expectations.text: Defines both lenses: impact materiality (inside-out) and financial materiality (outside-in), with a topic material if it meets either
expectations.evidence: "material from an impact perspective... a financial perspective... or both. Either is enough to report"

expectations.text: Describes the process: context/stakeholder mapping, identification of impacts/risks/opportunities, scoring with defined thresholds, validation and documentation
expectations.evidence: Steps 1-7: context and value-chain mapping, stakeholder identification, IRO identification, "Set scoring scales (for example 1 to 5), define thresholds and justify them", validate, document

expectations.text: Connects DMA output to disclosure scope: material topics drive which topical standards and datapoints apply (ESRS 2 general disclosures always apply)
expectations.evidence: "if a topic is not material, you need not report its disclosure requirements... ESRS 2 general disclosures are always required"

expectations.text: Reflects the revised-ESRS simplification accurately (fewer mandatory datapoints; relief provisions) without claiming the DMA itself was abolished
expectations.evidence: Treats revision as unenacted and vague: "The revised standards are still draft in my knowledge"; no fewer-mandatory-datapoint substance from the final act

expectations.text: Output is actionable: stepwise plan or table, with governance/audit-trail expectations for assurance readiness
expectations.evidence: Actionable 7-step walkthrough; "Keep evidence: workshop minutes, scoring, data sources, decisions. The assurer will test the DMA process"; board sign-off
